statusLegend.done: Shared source or test coverage exists and no OpenClaw-only source or test paths were found for this domain.
statusLegend.partial: Both repos have this domain, but OpenClaw has additional source paths or tests to map.
statusLegend.missing: OpenClaw has this domain and CoreBlow has no shared source or test path for it.
statusLegend.intentionally_different: CoreBlow-only domain; keep only when it is a deliberate CoreBlow product or architecture surface.

behaviorDecisionLegend: A domain can remain partial while a specific shared path deliberately keeps CoreBlow behavior that differs from OpenClaw.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw runs legacy multi-step state migrations across disk databases during doctor invocation.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow uses clean state initialization and WAL transactional storage without multi-version legacy migration steps.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Avoid runtime state corruption and reduce maintenance surface.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow consolidates provider authentication into modern CoreBlow auth profiles and CoreHub catalog entries.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Keep auth flows clean, deterministic, and free of legacy branching.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw routes plugin marketplace interactions through clawhub registry endpoints.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow uses the enterprise CoreHub package resolution engine (src/infra/corehub.ts, src/plugins/corehub-install-records.ts).
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Branding and registry decoupling: CoreBlow uses sovereign CoreHub package resolution without external clawhub dependencies.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw relies on openclaw.extension.json legacy declarations for package resolution.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow implements a minimal clean stub in src/plugins/legacy-npm-declaration.ts reading coreblow.extension.json with fallback.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Encapsulate legacy fallback behind OOP LegacyNpmPluginDeclarationReader stub without polluting core runtime.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw provides legacy migration provider runtime shims for deprecated extension schemas.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow drops migration provider shims in favor of typed CoreBlow manifests (src/plugins/manifest.ts).
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Enforce True Zero Gap Plugin SDK boundaries without legacy provider adapters.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw accepts non-standard JSON5 manifests with trailing commas, unquoted keys, and comments.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow enforces standard JSON manifests for deterministic, secure, and fast loading via src/plugins/manifest.ts.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Security and performance: standard JSON avoids AST overhead and unsafe object coercion during plugin discovery.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw ships standalone docker image packaging scripts for pruning dist directories.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow uses consolidated root build packaging and pnpm deploy workspaces.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Infrastructure simplification: CoreBlow standardizes on unified pnpm build pipelines without bespoke pruning scripts.
